title: [Bug] DELETE /api/analyses/:id missing ownership check - any user can delete any analysis
label: bug
body:
In routes/analyses.ts, DELETE /analyses/:id deletes by ID without checking analysis.userId === req.user.id. Any authenticated user can delete any analysis by guessing the serial integer ID.

**Fix:** Add ownership check before delete, return 403 if mismatch.

title: [Bug] PATCH /api/resumes/:id missing ownership check - any user can overwrite any resume
label: bug
body:
In routes/resumes.ts, PATCH /resumes/:id updates the row without verifying ownership before the update query runs. The check happens AFTER the update (checking the returned row), meaning the write already occurred.

**Fix:** Add a SELECT ownership check before the UPDATE.

title: [Bug] DELETE /api/resumes/:id missing ownership check - any user can delete any resume
label: bug
body:
The delete runs without verifying resume.userId === req.user.id before executing.

**Fix:** Add pre-delete ownership check and return 403 on mismatch.

title: [Security] GET /api/paystack/verify - reference not bound to authenticated user, enables account upgrade hijack
label: critical
body:
GET /paystack/verify?reference=xxx upgrades req.user.id to Pro if the reference is successful. A user who obtains another user's payment reference can use it to upgrade their own account instead.

**Fix:** Validate that the transaction metadata.userId matches req.user.id before upgrading.

title: [Bug] Free plan limit check happens AFTER inserting analyzing record - orphaned ghost records created
label: bug
body:
In POST /api/analyses, the 'analyzing' record is inserted BEFORE the plan limit check. When the limit is exceeded (HTTP 403), the ghost record remains with status='analyzing' forever.

**Fix:** Move the plan limit check before any DB inserts.

title: [Bug] JSON.parse in ai.ts has no try/catch - malformed OpenAI response causes unhandled 500
label: bug
body:
In lib/ai.ts line 78: JSON.parse(content) is not wrapped in try/catch. If OpenAI returns malformed JSON (which happens when max_tokens is hit mid-response), the server throws an unhandled error.

**Fix:** Wrap in try/catch and return a descriptive 500 error.

title: [Bug] AuthGate calls login() inside setTimeout during render - race condition causes multiple redirects
label: bug
body:
In App.tsx, when !isAuthenticated, login() is called via setTimeout(0). If the component re-renders before the timeout fires, multiple login() calls can be queued.

**Fix:** Use a ref flag or useEffect to ensure login() is called only once.

title: [Bug] Forgot Password link on login page is href='#' - completely non-functional
label: bug
body:
In pages/login.tsx, the forgot password anchor has href='#'. Clicking it does nothing. Users with forgotten passwords have no recovery path.

**Fix:** Implement forgot password using supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail().

title: [Bug] checkout-success.tsx shows success without verifying payment - failed payments display success screen
label: bug
body:
pages/checkout-success.tsx renders a success message without calling GET /api/paystack/verify. A user who navigates directly to /checkout/success sees a false confirmation.

**Fix:** Call /api/paystack/verify on mount and conditionally render success/failure states.

title: [Bug] Re-analyze passes resumeContent as URL query param - breaks for resumes over 2KB
label: bug
body:
In analysis-detail.tsx, handleReAnalyze() encodes full resumeContent into URLSearchParams. Browsers enforce ~2048 char URL limits. Long resumes silently truncate or cause navigation failure.

**Fix:** Use sessionStorage or a shared state store instead of URL params for large content.

title: [UX] Mobile sidebar does not close after navigation - user must manually dismiss it
label: enhancement
body:
After tapping a nav item on mobile, the sidebar remains open, obscuring the page content.

**Fix:** Call the sidebar close function from SidebarProvider context in the Link onClick handler.

title: [UX] No loading skeleton on Resumes page while data is fetching
label: enhancement
body:
The /resumes page shows a blank area while the resume list loads. There is no skeleton or spinner to indicate loading.

**Fix:** Add Skeleton components matching the resume card layout while isLoading is true.

title: [UX] Empty dashboard has no onboarding CTA for brand-new users with 0 analyses and 0 resumes
label: enhancement
body:
New users land on /dashboard and see zero-state stats with no guidance on what to do next.

**Fix:** Add an onboarding empty state card with a 'Start your first analysis' CTA linking to /analyze.

title: [Bug] Suggested Answer Tips button on Interview Prep tab is a non-functional placeholder
label: bug
body:
In analysis-detail.tsx, each interview question has a 'Suggested Answer Tips' Button with no onClick handler. It does nothing when clicked.

**Fix:** Either implement the feature (e.g. expand an answer tips section) or remove the button entirely.

title: [UX] No confirmation dialog before deleting an analysis or resume - accidental data loss
label: enhancement
body:
The delete buttons on analysis-detail and resumes pages execute immediately on click with no confirmation prompt.

**Fix:** Add an AlertDialog confirmation step before executing deletes.

title: [UX] History page has no pagination - all analyses load at once causing performance issues
label: enhancement
body:
GET /api/analyses returns all records. The history page renders every card at once. For users with hundreds of analyses this is very slow.

**Fix:** Implement cursor-based pagination on the API and infinite scroll or page controls on the frontend.

title: [UX] History page has no search or filter by job title, company, or score
label: enhancement
body:
Users cannot find a specific past analysis without scrolling through the entire list.

**Fix:** Add a search input that filters by jobTitle/companyName, and a score range slider filter.

title: [Bug] Analysis date displayed without timezone - shows different dates for users in different timezones
label: bug
body:
analysis-detail.tsx uses new Date(analysis.createdAt).toLocaleDateString() which varies by user locale and timezone. The stored timestamp is UTC so users in UTC+X see a different date.

**Fix:** Use a consistent display format with explicit timezone, e.g. toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { timeZone: 'UTC' }).

title: [Bug] Copy to clipboard fails silently on non-HTTPS origins - no error feedback to user
label: bug
body:
navigator.clipboard.writeText() is only available in secure contexts (HTTPS or localhost). On plain HTTP it throws, but the CopyButton component has no catch handler.

**Fix:** Add try/catch and fall back to document.execCommand('copy') with a user-facing error toast.

title: [Security] SSRF via /api/scrape/job - no URL allowlist blocks requests to internal network addresses
label: critical
body:
POST /api/scrape/job accepts any URL and makes a server-side HTTP request. An attacker can target 169.254.169.254 (cloud metadata), localhost, or internal services.

**Fix:** Parse the URL, resolve its hostname, and block RFC 1918, loopback, and link-local IP ranges.

title: [Security] CORS configured with origin:true - any origin can make credentialed requests in production
label: critical
body:
In app.ts: cors({ credentials: true, origin: true }). This reflects any Origin header, allowing any domain to make authenticated API calls with cookies.

**Fix:** Set origin to an explicit allowlist of trusted frontend domains from environment variables.

title: [Security] No file size limit on /api/resumes/extract - server can be DoS'd with large uploads
label: critical
body:
The multer config uses memoryStorage() with no limits option. An attacker can upload a multi-GB file, exhausting server RAM and crashing the process.

**Fix:** Add limits: { fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024 } (10MB) to the multer config.

title: [Security] MIME type not validated against file signature - file type can be spoofed via Content-Type header
label: critical
body:
resumes-extract.ts branches on req.file.mimetype which comes from the client's Content-Type header. A malicious file can have mimetype='application/pdf' while containing arbitrary data.

**Fix:** Use a magic-bytes library (e.g. the 'file-type' npm package) to verify the actual file signature.

title: [Security] In-memory rate limiter resets on server restart - DoS protection is ephemeral
label: critical
body:
The rate limiter uses an in-memory store. Every server restart clears all counters, allowing burst attacks immediately after restarts or deployments.

**Fix:** Back the rate limiter with a persistent store such as Redis.

title: [Security] No CSRF protection on any state-changing API endpoint
label: critical
body:
POST /api/analyses, POST /api/resumes, DELETE endpoints etc. accept cookie-based auth (sid cookie). Without CSRF tokens, cross-site requests can trigger state changes.

**Fix:** Add CSRF token validation (e.g. csurf middleware) or enforce SameSite=Strict on session cookies.

title: [Security] Paystack charge.success userId metadata is not validated - can be forged in test mode
label: critical
body:
In the Paystack webhook handler, the userId is taken directly from event.data.metadata.userId. In Paystack test mode, anyone can trigger a charge.success with a forged userId to upgrade arbitrary accounts.

**Fix:** Cross-reference the Paystack customer_code against paystackCustomerCode in the DB rather than trusting metadata.

title: [Security] /api/scrape/job is unauthenticated - acts as an open proxy for anyone on the internet
label: critical
body:
POST /api/scrape/job has no req.isAuthenticated() check. Any unauthenticated actor can use the endpoint as a free server-side HTTP proxy.

**Fix:** Add authentication check at the top of the scrape handler.

title: [Security] No audit log for sensitive operations - plan upgrades, deletions, and auth events not recorded
label: enhancement
body:
There is no audit trail for plan upgrades, analysis/resume deletions, or auth events. This makes incident response and fraud detection impossible.

**Fix:** Implement an audit_log table and record all sensitive operations with userId, action, and timestamp.

title: [Security] No account deletion flow - GDPR Article 17 right to erasure not implemented
label: critical
body:
Users have no way to delete their account and all associated data from within the app. This is required under GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure).

**Fix:** Add account deletion in Settings that removes all PostgreSQL data and calls supabase.auth.admin.deleteUser().

title: [Performance] GET /api/analyses returns full jobDescription and resumeContent in list view - huge payload
label: enhancement
body:
The analyses list endpoint returns every field including large text blobs. For a user with 100 analyses, this can be several MB per page load.

**Fix:** Return a summary projection (id, jobTitle, companyName, matchScore, status, createdAt) for list views. Full content only on GET /analyses/:id.

title: [Performance] No DB index on analyses.user_id - every history query does a full table scan
label: enhancement
body:
The analyses table has no index on user_id. Every call to GET /api/analyses does a sequential scan of the entire table.

**Fix:** Add CREATE INDEX idx_analyses_user_id ON analyses(user_id) via Drizzle migration.

title: [Performance] No DB index on resumes.user_id - resume list query does full table scan
label: enhancement
body:
Same issue as analyses.user_id - the resumes table has no index on user_id, causing sequential scans on every list request.

**Fix:** Add CREATE INDEX idx_resumes_user_id ON resumes(user_id).

title: [Performance] No DB index on analyses.created_at - ORDER BY created_at is a full sort on every request
label: enhancement
body:
Dashboard and history queries ORDER BY created_at DESC with no supporting index, causing a full sort on every request.

**Fix:** Add a composite index: CREATE INDEX idx_analyses_user_created ON analyses(user_id, created_at DESC).

title: [Performance] computeDiff LCS algorithm in analysis-detail.tsx is O(m*n) - freezes browser for long resumes
label: bug
body:
The diff view builds a full m*n DP matrix on the browser's main thread. For a 500-line resume, this is 250,000 operations synchronously, blocking the UI thread.

**Fix:** Run the diff in a Web Worker, or limit the diff to the first 200 lines with a 'show more' option.

title: [Performance] GET /dashboard/recent-analyses accepts unbounded limit param - can request millions of rows
label: critical
body:
The limit query param has no maximum value. A request with ?limit=999999999 will attempt to fetch millions of rows from the database.

**Fix:** Cap limit at a maximum of 50 and validate it is a positive integer.

title: [Data] keywordsMatched and keywordsMissing stored as TEXT JSON strings instead of JSONB
label: enhancement
body:
These columns are defined as text() in the Drizzle schema but contain JSON arrays. Using JSONB enables native array queries, GIN indexing, and eliminates manual JSON.parse/stringify on every read/write.

**Fix:** Migrate columns to jsonb type and remove manual serialization in route handlers.

title: [Data] interviewQuestions stored as TEXT JSON string instead of JSONB column
label: enhancement
body:
Same issue as keywords columns - interviewQuestions is text() containing a JSON array, requiring manual parse/stringify.

**Fix:** Migrate to jsonb type.

title: [Data] analyses.resume_id has no FK constraint to resumes table - referential integrity not enforced
label: bug
body:
In the analyses schema, resumeId is defined as integer('resume_id') without a .references() call. Deleting a resume leaves dangling resume_id values in analyses.

**Fix:** Add .references(() => resumesTable.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }) to the resumeId column.

title: [Data] usersTable.passwordHash column is never written or read - dead schema weight
label: enhancement
body:
The users schema defines passwordHash but it is never set anywhere in the codebase (Supabase handles auth). This column adds confusion for contributors.

**Fix:** Remove the column and create a Drizzle migration to drop it from the database.

title: [Data] No ON DELETE CASCADE on analyses.user_id - orphaned analyses if user record is deleted
label: bug
body:
If a user row is deleted from the users table, their analyses remain with a broken FK reference, causing data integrity issues.

**Fix:** Add onDelete: 'cascade' to the analyses userId FK reference in the Drizzle schema.

title: [Data] No ON DELETE CASCADE on resumes.user_id - orphaned resumes if user is deleted
label: bug
body:
Same cascade issue as analyses for the resumes table - deleting a user leaves orphaned resume rows.

**Fix:** Add onDelete: 'cascade' to the resumes userId FK.

title: [Data] analyses.matchScore defaults to 0 - analyzing records show as 0% match in history and skew average
label: bug
body:
While an analysis is in-progress (status='analyzing'), matchScore=0. This pollutes GET /dashboard/stats avg() calculation and shows misleading 0% scores in history.

**Fix:** Filter WHERE status='completed' in the avg() query; use null as matchScore default instead of 0.

title: [API] GET /api/resumes has no pagination - returns all resumes, will break at scale
label: enhancement
body:
The resumes endpoint returns all rows for a user with no limit or cursor, causing large payloads for users with many resumes.

**Fix:** Add limit/offset or cursor-based pagination with a default page size of 20.

title: [API] GET /api/analyses has no pagination - full analysis history returned on every request
label: enhancement
body:
The analyses list endpoint returns all records with no pagination. This will cause performance issues as users accumulate more analyses.

**Fix:** Add limit/offset pagination with a default page size of 20.

title: [API] API error responses are inconsistent - some return {error:string} others vary
label: enhancement
body:
Some endpoints return { error: 'message' }, others throw unhandled errors that Express formats differently. This makes client-side error handling unreliable.

**Fix:** Create a standardized error response helper and use it across all routes: { error: string, code?: string }.

title: [API] No ETag or Cache-Control headers on GET endpoints - clients cannot cache responses
label: enhancement
body:
None of the GET endpoints set ETag, Last-Modified, or Cache-Control headers. Browsers re-fetch on every navigation even when data hasn't changed.

**Fix:** Add ETag or Cache-Control headers to GET /analyses/:id and GET /resumes/:id.

title: [API] Missing interviewQuestions field in Analysis OpenAPI schema definition
label: bug
body:
The Analysis schema in openapi.yaml does not include the interviewQuestions field in its required or properties list, even though the API always returns it.

**Fix:** Add interviewQuestions (type: array, items: type: string) to the Analysis schema properties and required list.

title: [Auth] Supabase access token never refreshed client-side - sessions silently expire after 1 hour
label: critical
body:
The replit-auth-web library may not wire up supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange to auto-refresh tokens. After 1 hour, all API calls start returning 401 without user feedback.

**Fix:** Ensure onAuthStateChange is set up to refresh the session and update the auth context with the new token.

title: [Auth] Google OAuth users not synced to local DB on first request - race condition
label: bug
body:
Google OAuth redirects to /dashboard which immediately fires data-fetching requests. The authMiddleware auto-upsert may race with the first dashboard data request.

**Fix:** Ensure the OAuth callback URL explicitly calls POST /api/auth/sync before redirecting to /dashboard.

title: [Auth] No session invalidation on logout - JWT remains valid until natural expiry
label: critical
body:
Logging out via supabase.auth.signOut() clears the local token but the JWT itself remains valid on the server for up to 1 hour. There is no token blacklist.

**Fix:** Implement a server-side token revocation list, or reduce JWT expiry to 5 minutes with refresh token rotation.
